race.comment: BOLD SECRET (2) has found better here in his last two but is going well and only needs to hold his form to be fighting out the finish again. Will look likely throughout. EXTRA HOT (9) continues to leave herself with too much ground to bridge but is making good late inroads. Holder reunites after getting the best out of the mare three back at Murray Bridge. Big threat. IMPACT STORM (10) was denied by the barest of margins when resuming at Balaklava. Has been far less effective of late but has been freshened to try and gets things back on track. Not dismissing. AUSTRALIA FOREVER (8) was an eye-catching winner fresh when jumping out of the ground late. Couldn't quite repeat the dose last time when fav but is worth another chance third-up out to this trip. MELLIFLUENT (1) struck here third-up when racing much more prominently. Fitter again and loses nothing with Murtagh taking over.
